# The Nature Seeker

> > Travel guides and road trip itineraries for nature lovers exploring national parks, scenic drives, and outdoor destinations across the United States and beyond.

The Nature Seeker, created by travel writer Vitaliy Gershfeld, provides comprehensive first-time visitor guides and detailed road trip itineraries for discovering natural wonders, national parks, and scenic destinations. The site specializes in practical travel planning for outdoor enthusiasts seeking authentic nature experiences.

## Key Topics

- Road trip itineraries
- National parks visitor guides
- First-time visitor guides
- Scenic drives
- Nature travel destinations
- Hiking trails
- Beach destinations
- Vermont outdoor adventures
- Eastern United States travel
- Pacific Northwest exploration
- Route 66 journey
- Seychelles Islands
- UNESCO natural sites
- State park guides
- Outdoor adventure planning

## Epic Road Trip Itineraries

- [14 Day Route 66 Road Trip Itinerary](https://thenatureseeker.com/route-66-road-trip): 14-day Route 66 itinerary from Chicago to Santa Monica, 2,400 miles
- [10 Day Pacific Northwest Road Trip Itinerary](https://thenatureseeker.com/pacific-northwest-road-trip-itinerary): 10-day Pacific Northwest road trip from Seattle to Portland
- [My Crazy 1,500 Mile Road Trip in The Eastern United States](https://thenatureseeker.com/looking-for-fun-road-trip-ideas-try-this-1500-mile-one-i-did): 1,500-mile Eastern US road trip itinerary by Vitaliy Gershfeld
- [10 Wyoming Road Trip Ideas for Epic Adventures](https://thenatureseeker.com/wyoming-road-trip-ideas): 10 Wyoming road trip ideas for outdoor adventures and scenic routes
- [10 Pennsylvania Road Trip Ideas For New Visitors](https://thenatureseeker.com/pennsylvania-road-trip-ideas): 10 Pennsylvania road trip routes for first-time visitors
- [10 Best Scenic Drives in Arizona: A Guide to Unforgettable Road Trips](https://thenatureseeker.com/scenic-drives-in-arizona): Top 10 scenic drives through Arizona's deserts, forests, and canyons
- [10 Delaware Road Trip Ideas With Hidden Gems](https://thenatureseeker.com/delaware-road-trip-ideas): 10 Delaware road trip routes featuring hidden gems and attractions
